name: record-chain-written-for-another-key-selects-case-0
reference: spec 0.20, A switch on a decoded value; a switch key read inside an earlier `if` and chain block; x is content: the chain is written, y writes a zero bit and selects case 0, so val (else) is not written and p.2 is 0. FSPEC 80; 02 = y 0, x 000001, fx 0
